constraints: RESEARCH_SA only until a fresh Jev readiness judgment accepts the exact plan; this task may not mutate implementation source in its research PR.
The envelope is a non-authority projection over canonical graph/plan/evaluation state; it may explain legal transitions but cannot create claims, judgments, merge evidence or delivery receipts.
Preserve the two-lane model, current-only context semantics, exact candidate/evaluation/merge binding and independent Jev judgment.
An unclaimed MERGE_PENDING task may be materialized only when its exact work id is supplied; bootstrap must not auto-select PLANNED work or grant source-write authority.
Do not add session-history generations, a second workflow engine, repository-wide default discovery, or generic context-body retrieval in this task.
invariants: The envelope is derived from canonical task/plan/evaluation state and grants no authority beyond the existing lane/phase/source scope.
Only ACTIVE claimed work may be auto-selected; PLANNED/MERGE_PENDING is readable only by explicit exact work id and remains source-read-only.
Jev remains the semantic judge; candidate acceptance, merge verification and delivery publication stay separate trusted transitions.
Current-only context remains rebuildable and carries no history chain, previous-session transcript or implicit repository-wide discovery.
architectureDecisions: D1 — Add DELIVERY_ENVELOPE_V1 as a deterministic field of contracted deriveDeliveryContext output. The envelope contains kind/workId/lane/phase, exact subject bindings, currentGoal, entryConditions, requiredOutputs, exitConditions, nextActions and forbiddenActions.

D2 — Encode the phase table once in the delivery-context layer and project bootstrap intent/rules from the envelope rather than maintaining a second WORKER-wide intent table. Unknown lane/phase combinations fail closed.

D3 — RESEARCH/EXECUTION/REPAIR/JUDGMENT/MERGE_PENDING receive distinct goals and transitions. EXECUTION and REPAIR lead only to candidate/evidence collection; JUDGMENT is read-only and leads through materialize/evaluate/publish judgment; MERGE_PENDING is read-only and names merge preservation, verify:blackboard-delivery and publish:blackboard-delivery as separate steps.

D4 — Extend bootstrap selection so an explicitly supplied contracted PLANNED/WORKER/MERGE_PENDING task can be derived and materialized without a claim/current.json. Implicit bootstrap selection remains ACTIVE-only, so this read path cannot become a scheduler or claim bypass.

D5 — Materialized interactive context exposes the delivery envelope verbatim. It does not duplicate full control-plane docs or expand generic dependency bodies; progressive discovery remains bounded by the existing context contract.

D6 — The envelope subject includes only already-bound identifiers (semanticArtifactRef, planRef/planHash and phase-relevant candidate/evaluation/evidence/merge refs). Missing required phase identity fails closed rather than being represented as success.
D7 — AGENTS.md and Living system state explain that fresh agents follow the envelope for immediate delivery obligation while canonical graph/plan/Jev/merge artifacts remain authority.
implementationSlices: S1 — Delivery envelope contract [PHASE_CONTEXT, AUTHORITY]: define and validate DELIVERY_ENVELOPE_V1 from canonical delivery state; add per-phase goals, exact subject bindings, entry/exit conditions, legal next actions and forbidden actions with fail-closed unknown/missing identities.

S2 — Bootstrap projection and merge-pending resume [BOOTSTRAP, MERGE_RESUME]: project intent/rules from the envelope; allow explicit read-only PLANNED/MERGE_PENDING bootstrap without current.json while preserving ACTIVE-only implicit selection and no claim mutation.

S3 — Cold-start negative coverage [PHASE_CONTEXT, BOOTSTRAP, MERGE_RESUME, AUTHORITY]: add a focused context test that constructs phase fixtures and proves judgment/merge-pending cannot advertise implementation authority, no implicit PLANNED selection occurs and direct DONE is never a legal action.
S4 — Operator truth [PHASE_CONTEXT]: update AGENTS.md and Living system state to describe the envelope as non-authority onboarding context and retain graph/plan/Jev/merge receipts as canonical truth.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A fresh session given an exact PLANNED/WORKER/MERGE_PENDING work id can materialize read-only finalization context without claiming the task or creating current.json; implicit bootstrap still selects only ACTIVE work, and the envelope names merge preservation, exact verify:blackboard-delivery and publish:blackboard-delivery as separate required steps.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The onboarding envelope is non-authority: it cannot transition directly to DONE, cannot fabricate candidate/evaluation/merge identity, and cannot bypass Jev judgment, exact merge-tree verification or delivery publication.
